================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YA AFTER EFFECTS - ZATSOPANO
Mtundu 9.2.9  -  Okutobala 2026
================================================================================

Ma THEME A ANIME atsopano 33 alowa nawo pa a Demon Slayer, ma effect a mbewa a ma
theme tsopano akuwonekadi mkati mwa After Effects, ndipo Kusankha Theme tsopano ndi
mndandanda umodzi wotsika wokonzedwa bwino.

MUSANAYAMBE
- Ikani pamwamba pa mtundu wanu wapano pogwiritsa ntchito ZXP installer yanu yanthawi
  zonse, kenako yambitsaninso After Effects kamodzi.
- Zokonda zanu, theme, ma preset ndi ma expression osungidwa zimasungidwa.

ZATSOPANO: MA THEME A ANIME 33
- Zokonda za Flex > KUSANKHA THEME > THEME YA PANEL tsopano ili ndi gulu limodzi pa
  anime iliyonse:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan (Okarun),
  Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter
  x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba
  (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto
  (Itachi, Minato), One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero
  (Rem), Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) ndi Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Munthu aliyense ali ndi mawonekedwe ake: chomwe chimatsatira mbewa yanu, kuukira
  mukadina batani, zomwe zimachitika mukagwira batani lakumanzere, ndi kuphulika
  mutagwira kwa masekondi pafupifupi 2.5.
- Ndi opepuka ngati ma theme a Demon Slayer: ma effect amagwira ntchito pokhapokha
  mukusuntha mbewa kapena kudina. Zimitsani MA EFFECT OZUNGULIRA kuti mutsale ndi
  mitundu yokha.

ZASINTHA: KUSANKHA THEME
- Makadi a Demon Slayer omwe anali pansi pa THEME YA PANEL achotsedwa, choncho Zokonda
  za Flex zafupika. Sankhani theme iliyonse pa mndandanda wotsika wa THEME YA PANEL;
  umatseguka pa theme yomwe mukugwiritsa ntchito.
- Kurama ndi Baryon tsopano ali mu gulu la Naruto.

ZOKONZEDWA
- Ma effect a mbewa a ma theme (madzi, malawi, mphezi ndi zina) nthawi zambiri
  sankawoneka mkati mwa After Effects, ngakhale Mode Yokonzedwa Bwino itazimitsidwa.
  Nthawi zomwe panel yokha inali yotanganidwa, komanso kuyamba kotanganidwa,
  zinkaganiziridwa ngati theme ikuchedwa, choncho ma effect ankadzizimitsa okha.
  Tsopano, khadi lanu la zithunzi likamawajambula (makompyuta ambiri), nthawi zimenezo
  zimangopangitsa ma effect kukhala opepuka kwa kanthawi.

ZOSASINTHA
- Laisensi, activation ndi maulalo onse zimagwira ntchito monga kale.
- Ma theme 11 a Demon Slayer akuwoneka chimodzimodzi monga mu 9.2.8.
- Tabu ina iliyonse ndi chida chilichonse zimagwira ntchito chimodzimodzi monga mu
  9.2.8.
================================================================================

- GWIRIZANITSANI FOOTER ikazimitsidwa mu Zokonda za Flex, mauthenga otsimikizira

  yakale theme itasintha. Tsopano umawonetsa nthawi zonse theme yomwe yayatsidwa.
